title: External HTTP/3 Peer Harness Verification
verification_method: Build, requirement-home tests, plan-only harness run, live focused external-peer harness run, parser smoke test, and SpecTrace validation.
scope: Verify that the external HTTP/3 harness surfaces the requested peer/scenario matrix, produces explicit pass/fail/skip results, and retains qlog, key-log, pcap, stdout/stderr, and decoded-summary artifacts without claiming broad HTTP/3 support.
procedure: Run a focused live subset such as `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/interop/http3-external/Run-Http3ExternalInterop.ps1 -Targets incursa-client__incursa-server,aioquic-client__incursa-server,incursa-client__aioquic-server -Scenarios get-small,not-found`.
expected_result: The build and requirement-home tests pass, plan-only execution emits rows for every requested target/scenario pair, the focused live subset passes or preserves concrete fail/skip evidence, the parser emits a Markdown matrix, scenario artifact directories contain command/stdout/stderr/summary files, peer-tool-manifest.json records Docker, Compose, image, and pinned aioquic acquisition metadata, service qlog and key-log directories are mounted for peers, optional pcaps are retained when supplied, and skipped rows stay visible. Status "skip" is a first-class result and must not be converted into support claims.
evidence: 2026-05-25: `dotnet build Incursa.Quic.slnx -c Release --no-restore` passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors after restore generated assets for the new sample client.

2026-06-19: `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/interop/http3-external/Run-Http3ExternalInterop.ps1 -PlanOnly -Targets incursa-client__incursa-server,curl__incursa-server,aioquic-client__incursa-server,quiche-client__incursa-server,ngtcp2-client__incursa-server,incursa-client__aioquic-server,incursa-client__quiche-server,incursa-client__ngtcp2-server -Scenarios get-small,get-large,not-found` produced `.artifacts/http3-external/20260619T055646Z/results.jsonl`, `report.md`, and `peer-tool-manifest.json` with 24 explicit plan-only rows after comma-separated array normalization.

2026-06-19: `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/interop/http3-external/Run-Http3ExternalInterop.ps1 -Targets incursa-client__incursa-server,aioquic-client__incursa-server,incursa-client__aioquic-server -Scenarios get-small,not-found` produced `.artifacts/http3-external/20260619T055801Z/results.jsonl`, `report.md`, `udp-reachability-report.md`, and `peer-tool-manifest.json`; the focused live Docker subset passed 6/6 across Incursa control, aioquic-client to Incursa-server, and Incursa-client to aioquic-server static GET-style rows.
status_summary: Complete for the advisory harness/reporting slice. The generated plan-only evidence proves the matrix and parser surface, and the focused live Docker evidence characterizes the static aioquic/Incursa GET-style rows as passing. This remains external-peer characterization, not broad HTTP/3 or QPACK support promotion.
